name: NastyLand
source:
Strings of many fates lay in front of you.
You may observe and control them.
Hear the sounds from the fissures of space and time.
What will you see? What will you know?

[From [url=https://nastyzeus.itch.io/nastyland]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
许多命运的弦就摆在你的面前。
你可以观察并控制它们。
聆听来自时空裂缝的声音。
你会看到什么？你会知道什么？

[来自[url=https://nastyzeus.itch.io/nastyland]Itch.io[/url]]
